questions.q: Which is the highest peak in Pakistan?
questions.why: At 8,611 m it is also the second-highest peak in the world.

questions.q: K2 is located in which mountain range?
questions.why: It sits on the Pakistan-China border in Gilgit-Baltistan.

questions.q: Nanga Parbat belongs to which range?
questions.why: It marks the western end of the Great Himalaya.

questions.q: What is the highest peak of the Hindu Kush?
questions.why: At 7,708 m, it stands in Chitral. Rakaposhi is in the Karakoram.

questions.q: How many of the world's fourteen 8,000-metre peaks are in Pakistan?
questions.why: K2, Nanga Parbat, Gasherbrum I, Broad Peak and Gasherbrum II.

questions.q: Which is the longest glacier in the Karakoram?
questions.why: Siachen is about 76 km long. Biafo and Baltoro come next.

questions.q: The Khunjerab Pass connects Pakistan with which country?
questions.why: The Karakoram Highway crosses the border here.

questions.q: Which peak is known as the "Killer Mountain"?
questions.why: Don't mix it up with K2, which is called the "Savage Mountain".

questions.q: The Khyber Pass lies in which range?
questions.why: Safed Koh is also called Spin Ghar. The pass links Peshawar with Torkham and Kabul.

questions.q: The Bolan Pass connects which two places?
questions.why: Quetta and Chaman are linked by the Khojak Pass instead.

questions.q: The Khojak Pass is in which range?
questions.why: The Khojak railway tunnel runs beneath it.

questions.q: The hill station Fort Munro lies in which range?
questions.why: It is near Dera Ghazi Khan.

questions.q: The Shandur Pass connects:
questions.why: It hosts the famous Shandur polo festival.

questions.q: Which range forms the border between Sindh and Balochistan?
questions.why: It runs north to south along the provincial boundary.

questions.q: Gorakh Hill, the "Murree of Sindh", is part of which range?
questions.why: It lies near Dadu.

questions.q: Pakistan's nuclear tests of 28 May 1998 were carried out in:
questions.why: The Ras Koh Hills are in Chagai district, north-western Balochistan.

questions.q: The Khewra Salt Mine is located in:
questions.why: It is in Jhelum district, Punjab.

questions.q: What is the highest point of the Salt Range?
questions.why: Sakesar is about 1,522 m. Tilla Jogian is a well-known but lower hill in the same range.

questions.q: The Salt Range lies between which two rivers?
questions.why: The Potohar Plateau lies to its north.

questions.q: The Margalla Hills are part of:
questions.why: They rise on the northern edge of Islamabad.

questions.q: The Lowari Pass connects:
questions.why: The Lowari Tunnel now keeps the route open in winter.

questions.q: Rakaposhi overlooks which valley?
questions.why: It is a Karakoram peak, visible from the Karakoram Highway.

questions.q: In which year was K2 first climbed?
questions.why: An Italian expedition made the first ascent. 1953 is the year of Nanga Parbat's first ascent, a common trap.

questions.q: The Reko Diq copper-gold deposit is located in:
questions.why: It is in Balochistan, close to the Saindak project.

questions.q: The Gomal Pass lies in which region?
questions.why: It links Dera Ismail Khan with Afghanistan.
